additional_info.subject: RE: AW: AW: ID0436218-DC/Si-D/DE-[MP / R4 170001715]Charging issue CRM:02698000322
additional_info.body:
Good morning Herr Hentzschel,
I am reaching out form the Expert Services Team in regards of ticket
ID0436218.
The ticket is opened for charging power limitation to 27kW on the charger
MP / R4 170001715
.
I performed a screening of the charger performance over the last weeks, and indeed there is a power limitation. From the logs, it seems clear that this power limitation is coming from the External Load Management System. I report you here some logs for your understanding:
18.07.2025
​​​​​​​
I analyzed a charging session performed on 18.07.2025 around 15:40 CET time.
The outlet DC2 initiates the charging session at 2025-07-18T13:36:26 UTC, and we can see the following message:
2025-07-18T13:37:19.936964+00:00 [FW070005G1] swcpu [user:debug] [4129] [ELM]  DC2 outlet power ELMS limit < CG.MaxPower Limit, PLimEvseSetpactive = 30 kW, PlimElmsOutlet = 27.1 kW, PlimCGmax = 160 kW
THE ELMS is limiting the total power of the EVSE to 30kW. Because the charger has a own consumption around 3kW, the power limit to the outlet (only one in use in this case) is 27kW.
At 2025-07-18T13:41:16 DC1 is initiated. The limits of the power available comes as follows:
2025-07-18T13:41:53.104348+00:00 [FW070005G1] swcpu [user:debug] [4129] [ELM]  DC1 outlet power ELMS limit < CG.MaxPower Limit, PLimEvseSetpactive = 30 kW, PlimElmsOutlet = 13.5 kW, PlimCGmax = 80 kW
Because the limitation of the total power of the EVSE is still 30, the ELMS limits the outlet power to 13.5kW, as in this case there are 2 outlets charging in parallel.
At 2025-07-18T13:56:01 also the AC outlet is connected. All 3 outlets are limited to 9kW each.
29.07.2025
​​​​​​​
At 2025-07-29T12:29:40, a charging session is initiated on DC1. Follows the power limit set by the ELMS:
2025-07-29T12:30:30.121673+00:00 [FW070005G1] swcpu [user:debug] [4129] [ELM]  DC1 outlet power ELMS limit < CG.MaxPower Limit, PLimEvseSetpactive = 30 kW, PlimElmsOutlet = 27.1 kW, PlimCGmax = 160 kW
On the same day, at 2025-09-29T13:11:51 I see that the charger is disconnected from the ELMS.
2025-07-29T13:11:51.642985+00:00 [FW070005G1] swcpu [user:debug] [4129] [ELM]  SICHARGE -> ELMS (status): charger ready = false
The subsequent charging sessions happens in the evening, with no ELMS connected, and as you can see there is no power limitation to 27kW:
The DC2 outlet is charging at 92kW, following EV's current request.
I hope I brought clarity to your doubts with this technical explanation.
In case you require more information or clarification, do not hesitate to contact me. Looking forward to hearing from you soon!
With kind regards,
Fosco Servidei
